hypothesis: Failure pattern: the player cannot read what story options cost the three promotion inputs, so careers stay at the entry level and are dismissed for capability at month 24. In all 9 misses the short input had been at its high after the last Energy phase, or reached it in a later story, and a later story choice took it away; on every losing choice the player's note expected no cost or a gain. Losing choices by miss: rest while work waited, at Health 5 to 9, with the work called non-urgent (4 misses); a note or record written for others, read as free goodwill or visible results (3); a side review or meeting, read as a relationship or visibility chance (2); learning on the job (1); passing up learning (2); turning down, correcting or going over a colleague, including a light touch with an intern meant to protect Output (4).
